about: Government and elections family: links a law lacks by its own terms (scripts/law-wiring/matrix.ts reads every file here). Each why says what in the statute makes it so.

reach.why: the ban binds former officeholders (a cooling-off period before they may lobby), and every officeholder is a full person by the two-level rule (AGENTS.md, two-level population), so no counted group can be in its reach; the full people it reached are named in the evidence

term limits bind legislators at the filing check, and every officeholder and candidate is a full person by the two-level rule (AGENTS.md, two-level population), so no counted group can be in its reach; the full people it reached are named in the evidence
